purpose: Escape invertible group-cocycle cancellation using singular binary matrices and direct cyclic trace invariance.
observable: trace over F2 of ordered products of Mat2(F2) labels on spatial windows
checks: Exact all-length decision by reachable linear spans of paired old/new matrix products in the deBruijn graph; nonconstancy witness at fixed lengths up to8. No finite ring cutoff is used for invariance.
controls: scalar direct cycle enumeration for selected assignments
scope_limits: F2 trace cannot detect ordinary Z2 parity represented in characteristic2; a negative does not eliminate noninvertible invariants generally.
Only two-by-two binary matrices and width1/2, not all finite memories.
